text:
emily: quick heads-up - postdeploy smoke on prefill route in apac-southeast1 showing elevated 5xx for short-prefill samples (10/200 -> 5%). noticed right after image flip.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: release-2026-03-23 started 2026-03-23T02:10Z. Rollout progress: 45%. Canary checks: PASS. Postdeploy synth: WARNING: prefill 5xx spike. https://deploy/release-2026-03-23

jon: pulled logs from apac-southeast1-b. Seeing repeated `kv-warmup timeout` in runtime which leads proxy -> 502. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-23T02:12:11Z] kv-warmup INFO start
[2026-03-23T02:12:15Z] kv-warmup ERR timeout after 4s
[2026-03-23T02:12:15Z] proxy INFO upstream 502
```

rachel: could be a warmup race for prefix cache after host replacement. options: 1) pin prefill route in apac to previous model variant, 2) reduce rollout further, 3) kick kv-warmup again via sidecar restart. prefer 3 first.

ops-bot: Mitigation suggestions: restart warmup sidecars on affected hosts -> fast; if issue persists, regional pin to model-prefill-2.1. Escalate to rollback if >3% 5xx sustained for 20m.

emily: ok holding rollout at 45%. I'll soft-restart warmup sidecars in apac-southeast1-b now and run targeted smoke (200 samples). command: 
```
redwoodctl host restart-sidecar --region apac-southeast1 --service kv-warmup --filter host=apac-southeast1-b
```

health-bot: smoke job started: id=smoke-1851239876-1 region=apac-southeast1 samples=200 type=postdeploy-prefill

ops-bot: sidecars restarted on hosts apac-southeast1-b.{1..3} by emily. No config change.

health-bot: smoke complete: id=smoke-1851239876-1 results: 200/200 OK, 0/200 5xx, p95=98ms, notes="requests served after sidecar restart; pinned variant not required"

jon: nice. leave rollout paused for 15m observation then continue to 70% if metrics stay clean. I'll open a follow-up to add a warmup preflight check to canary job.

emily: agreed. creating release-note blurb and assigning follow-up to infra: "postdeploy: apac prefill 5xx spike; resolved by restarting kv-warmup sidecars; added canary preflight proposal."

deploy-bot: Rollout hold recorded by emily. Observability window: 15m. Next auto-action: resume -> 70% if no alerts.
